entries.name: paper-01-worn
entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction. Input image is an edit target and texture reference. Deliver ONLY the blank cream paper panel as a standalone game UI resource PNG with genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the paper. REMOVE every word, letter, number, illustration, Cubero character, its shadow, close X, close-button square, all UI controls and all peach scene background. Fill their former areas seamlessly with matching paper texture. Exactly one blank tall rounded rectangular paper sheet, front-facing flat orthographic view, roughly same panel proportions as reference (width:height about 0.62), vertically straight, centered with narrow transparent margin. Full silhouette visible, no crop. No cast shadow outside silhouette, no glow or matte fringe. Paper itself opaque with soft natural material shading. No text, symbols, decoration, watermark, checkerboard pixels or background color. Soft worn paper. Preserve its gently rubbed rounded edges, fine fibres, faint irregular shallow creases and warm ivory color. No curled or folded corners. This is an isolated reusable resource, NOT a screenshot or mockup. Preserve the cozy warm cream paper style from input, broad light quiet center.
